executionEvidenceContract.artifact_evidence: Case-specific bounded JSON object, containing real artifact/readback/process/procedure observations selected by fixed host case/scorer; canonical hash must equal trusted artifact_evidence_sha256. Never execute submitted program on host or accept self-scored success. Root-specific scorer checks actual artifacts through the existing isolated programming/procedure route.
executionEvidenceContract.binding_checks: stage must be development. Fixed registration, case set, baseline, scope and each runtime binding equal trusted config; source equals exact current report leg; strategy_sha256 equals the trusted per-source run binding. run_bindings_sha256 hashes the independently host-recorded binding file. SHA fields are lowercase64hex. Installed or broader source claims are forbidden.
executionEvidenceContract.files: For each exact report leg, load evidence_root/<source_sha256>.json and run_bindings_root/<source_sha256>.json. Never accept a candidate-provided path. Source is report.baseline_sha256 or report.candidate_sha256, respectively.
executionEvidenceContract.hard_checks: All four conditions must be true booleans and hash-match trusted host records; missing, false or unknown fails closed. Focused existing composition/authorization/cancellation tests must prove these producer checks before native execution; absent events alone are not proof.
executionEvidenceContract.help_checks: Nonnegative strict integer counters equal host-observed records/hash; actual corrective input cannot be hidden as initial task/setup. Metrics are computed by fixed scorer; help numbers from candidate stdout are ignored.
executionEvidenceContract.not_implemented: This contract only binds already measured work; it starts no provider, worker, daemon, queue, network, credentials mount or cache. The trusted producer using the existing worker/provider/programming route is still required before meaningful execution.
executionEvidenceContract.permissions: Both roots must be absolute nonsymlink paths with every ancestor nonsymlink, uid=os.geteuid(), directory mode0700. Files must be regular nonsymlink single-link files, uid=os.geteuid(), mode0600 or0400, bounded to8MiB. Candidate containers/workspaces cannot write either root.
executionEvidenceContract.run_bindings_origin: Trusted host owns run bindings. Task/session/ingress/case/source identity is fixed before dispatch; after completion, original immutable host/journal receipt and usage/help/hard/artifact exports supply expected hashes. Freeze this per-source completed binding before scoring. Completion hashes are observations, not new criteria; no model or candidate may author/modify them.
executionEvidenceContract.run_checks: Exact expected case-ID set and one run per case; task/session unique within a series and match trusted run bindings; source ingress and actual receipt hashes match; no foreign/duplicate/replayed run substituted under another source/case/session. Each task status is a known terminal outcome (succeeded/failed/stopped/ambiguous/timed_out); only complete measured outcomes are rankable. A succeeded status alone is not behavioral success.
executionEvidenceContract.scoring: Existing failed/incomplete/truncated networkless report legs remain failures. Otherwise the optional mode passes this validated work evidence (not candidate stdout) to the existing scorer(cases, outputs). Same fixed criteria and reference sample remain identical across compare entries; resource-only changes cannot prove semantic gain.
executionEvidenceContract.usage_checks: measurement=measured, unknown_attempts=0, all counters nonnegative strict integers, total=input+output, provider_attempts=len(request_ids), globally unique nonempty physical request IDs within series, sum(role attempts)=provider_attempts. Exactly admitted role combinations: contact=gpt-6-sol/none; work or helper=gpt-6-astra/medium. Check every helper against the same case/series cap. Values must match trusted usage_sha256; partial native stored usage is not complete physical journal usage. Missing/unknown attempts are unrankable, never silently zero.

executionReadiness: NO_GO: evidence interface/producer, frozen question fixtures/scorer, exact installed composition/profile and original current authority are not yet all present. These criteria do not authorize provider/model execution.

existingInterfaceFit.ComponentEvaluator: Keep its networkless no-credential execution as literal/source-boundary and static control evidence. Do not give candidate containers provider/network access.
existingInterfaceFit.DevelopmentAssessment: Fixed host criteria/scorer and compatible comparison are reusable. Current stdout-only networkless runs cannot themselves measure real provider/worker behavior.
existingInterfaceFit.HostFinalAssessment: The existing answer_evidence_file/complete stage already supports separately hash-bound actual work evidence; keep the fixed protected scorer and existing registration/retained queue.
existingInterfaceFit.compare: Preserve fixed criteria and exact reference metrics across all comparisons. Use the one sealed registered baseline sample as receipt input; no new cache or reference/reset policy.

protectedFinalCriteria.promotionRequires: Strict independently observed correctness/autonomy gain, no per-case regression and no hard-boundary failure. Ties and resource-only gains retain baseline.

providerBudget.qualification: Ceilings include candidate construction, all baseline/candidate development, selected-finalist versus baseline final tasks and one later use. Every helper shares its parent grant. This registration grants no model execution; ordinary live authority/profile checks and fixed manifest admission are still required. No latency or efficiency promotion rule.

publicDevelopmentCriteria.objective: Complete real programming deliverables with independently checked executable behavior and no extra human repair; resource savings or matching instruction words alone do not prove intelligence.

publicDevelopmentTaskContracts.behavior_oracle: Three fixed independent checks: normal input, boundary/empty input, invalid-input handling. Score actual executed outputs, exit codes and physical source/result identities.
publicDevelopmentTaskContracts.planning_observation: Unnecessary save_work_progress calls are recorded as overhead only, not as intelligence or a semantic promotion metric.
publicDevelopmentTaskContracts.required_result: One runnable JSON-stdin/stdout Python program and its durable separately read-back output for a small completely specified transformation.

publicDevelopmentTaskContracts.behavior_oracle: Three fixed independent checks plus exact saved-source reuse and independent output readback; an ACK/designation/exitcode alone is insufficient.
publicDevelopmentTaskContracts.progress_observation: Record meaningful saved progress tied to completed artifact/verification transitions and honest terminal state. Counting calls or matching planning words is insufficient.
publicDevelopmentTaskContracts.required_result: A larger multi-stage programming deliverable, actual checks and durable output, followed by resolving/executing the same exact saved procedure on different input without new implementation.

qualityObjective: Actual correct programming deliverables and less required human repair, including a simple task without unnecessary planning overhead and a larger task with honest progress and exact saved-source reuse. No keyword/text score or isolated exitcode is intelligence evidence.
smallestMissingInterface: Optional host-only work_evidence binding in existing DevelopmentAssessment: load verified per-source real-work evidence and independent run bindings, validate exact source/case/role/profile/task/session/usage/help/hard/artifact identities, then pass that evidence into the same fixed scorer. It performs no models or task dispatch. A separately admitted producer on the existing worker/provider/programming route must create these real records; that producer is not proven by this receipt.
sourceBoundaryAdvice: A pure <=4096UTF8 literal-return _TaskModel._work_strategy containing the unchanged default planning paragraph is an appropriately narrow source/application boundary. This scope decision is not a source/install GO.
